description:
Section 73 application for the variation of Condition 2 (Approved Plans) of Planning Permission Ref: P2025/0313/FUL approved for: “Demolition of existing mansard roof extension and replacement with a part 4th and 5th floor roof extension to provide additional hotel accommodation, and refurbishment and reconfiguration of an existing hotel and public house (Sui Generis).  The proposed variations to the approved plans include internal alterations and layout changes, resulting in an increase in room sizes, a reduction in the total number of hotel rooms from 34 to 28, and the provision of wheelchair refuge accommodation.  Associated alterations include:

- Addition of accessible rooms adjacent to the lift (4th & 5th Floors)
- Rearrangement of Back of House areas to accommodate building services (Basement)
- Installation of building services risers (2nd–5th Floors)
- Relocation of cycle store from ground floor to basement
- Standardisation of en-suite bathrooms for construction (1st–5th Floors)
- Removal of home cinema space (Basement)
- Improved access to pub WCs (Basement)
- Addition of internal insulation wall lining (Basement)
- Removal of internal light-well and omission of light-well facing rooms (1st–5th Floors)
- Update of north boundary wall location in line with new survey data (affects all floors)
- Relocation of Part M compliant rooms (1st Floor)
- Increase in pub demise at basement level (Basement)
- Revision of pub demise to right-hand side of party wall only, with relocated accessible WC (Ground Floor)
- Revised room layouts to provide larger rooms (1st–5th Floors)
- Revision of secondary stair (Stair B) to meet building regulations (2nd–4th Floors)
- Addition of wheelchair refuge at Stair B (5th Floor)
- Revision of stair cores (Ground–5th Floors)
- Reduction in total rooms per floor from 7 to 6 (1st–5th Floors)
